scoring_justification: Headline quantities (4f occupation weights, magnetic moment) are directly produced by DFT calculations which the verifier cannot rerun. The checker compares the reported values to paper-reported gold. DOS is verified by a structural audit of the double-peak feature.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold target values for 4f occupation weights (0.240, 0.020, 0.018) and magnetic moment (1.25 μB) are taken directly from the paper text (Section 3, paragraph starting 'The number of occupied electrons...'). The DOS structural audit parameters (peak search range, ratio threshold) are derived from the paper's description of the anomalous DOS with the Fermi level between two peaks. All values are paper-reported, not fabricated.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper statements; tolerance 0.02 for weights and 0.05 μB for moment reflect expected DFT code variability.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Exact numbers are explicitly stated in the paper.

outputs.description: Occupied weights for the three Kramers doublets of the j=5/2 manifold.
Total density of states near the Fermi level, used to verify the double-peak anomaly.
Total 4f magnetic moment per Ce atom under H=5 T.

output_contract.notes: The exact_match outputs (4f weights, magnetic moment) are compared to hidden paper-reported values with appropriate tolerance. The DOS output is audited for the Fermi-level double-peak feature.
